items.title: Bracco, Avicenna.AI get FDA clearance for brain aneurysm AI software
items.excerpt: Bracco and Avicenna.AI received FDA 510(k) clearance for Uptunity Aneurysm, AI software that detects suspected saccular brain aneurysms larger than 3 mm on head CTA and tracks known aneurysms across exams. It is the first product in Bracco's Uptunity interpretive-AI portfolio.

items.title: AI risk tool targets supplemental breast MRI to cut early detection failures
items.excerpt: RSNA 2026 preview: researchers will report the ScreenTrustMRI trial, which tested whether an AI risk predictor can select which screened women benefit most from supplemental MRI to catch cancers mammography misses.

items.title: AI helps narrow experience gap between mammography readers
items.excerpt: RSNA 2026 preview: a multi-reader study of 2,430 screening mammograms (33 cancers) tests whether AI assistance improves junior readers more than seniors and closes the experience gap.

items.title: AI improves rare kidney cancer diagnosis, but overreliance poses risks: AMC study
items.excerpt: An Asan Medical Center deep-learning tool raised 21 physicians' accuracy in diagnosing fumarate hydratase-deficient renal cell carcinoma from 60.0% to 73.3%, but readers who leaned on it more were also likelier to accept its wrong calls.

items.title: 삼성서울병원, 글로벌 의료 AI 기업 '하이디'와 협력
items.excerpt: 삼성서울병원이 하이디(Heidi)와 MOU를 맺고 자체 의료정보시스템 '다윈'에 진료 음성-텍스트 변환(앰비언트 AI 기록) 도입을 추진한다. 하이디의 첫 국내 진출로, 원격의료·예약용 AI 에이전트 협력도 포함된다.

items.title: Dyania Health, Nvidia team up to bring clinical reasoning AI inside hospital networks
items.excerpt: Dyania Health will run its Synapsis clinical-reasoning AI on hospital-owned Nvidia systems so large-scale chart analysis (e.g., trial matching at Cleveland Clinic) happens without patient data leaving the hospital network.

items.title: Patient comfort with AI's clinical decisions tied to provider oversight: Gallup
items.excerpt: A Gallup poll finds over half of U.S. adults would accept AI making diagnosis or treatment decisions if a clinician can review and override them, while only about a third of providers think patients would.

items.title: Is AI Really Saving Hospitals Money? A New Study Raises Questions About the Cost of AI-Driven Care
items.excerpt: A New England Journal of Medicine study suggests AI-generated care plans can cost far more than those ordered by physicians, challenging the assumption that clinical AI cuts spending.

items.title: Challenges for human oversight in detecting system malfunctions in AI-assisted medical diagnostics
items.excerpt: In a randomized study of 48 physicians using an increasingly malfunctioning AI for cardiac auscultation, diagnostic performance fell alongside the AI's reliability, showing clinicians struggle to catch AI failures.

items.title: Multicenter benchmarking of large language models for bladder cancer management recommendations from mpMRI reports
items.excerpt: Following TRIPOD-LLM, a multicenter retrospective study tests whether LLMs can turn bladder cancer multiparametric MRI reports into guideline-concordant management recommendations.

items.title: Development and validation of a machine learning model to predict the daily risk of febrile neutropenia in patients with AML undergoing chemotherapy
items.excerpt: Using registry data from two Finnish university hospitals, researchers built and validated an ML screening tool that predicts day-by-day febrile neutropenia risk in AML patients on chemotherapy.

items.title: 에이아이트릭스 "AITRICS-VC 고시 위반 사실 무근, 적법 사용 중"
items.excerpt: 환자 상태 악화 예측 AI 'AITRICS-VC'가 혈액검사를 실측하지 않아 신의료기술 고시를 위반했다는 주장에 에이아이트릭스가 반박했다. 부당이득 반환 소송 1심 2건은 의료기관 승소, 식약처도 결측치 보정을 허가 사항으로 확인했다.

items.title: AI chatbots aren't therapists. But can they finally get men to open up?
items.excerpt: STAT examines whether AI chatbots can reach men who avoid mental health care, weighing the Therabot randomized trial's symptom reductions and its critics as FDA signals a new approach to mental-health AI.

items.title: 강원 공공병원에 '의료 AI 고속도로' 첫 개통
items.excerpt: 보건복지부가 강원대병원과 영월의료원을 실시간 연결하는 '공공의료 AI 고속도로'를 시범 개통했다. 전원부터 수술·퇴원·회송까지 AI로 잇고, 2029년까지 전국 72개 공공병원으로 확대한다.

items.title: 의료 AI 도입하고 분만실 되살리고…영월의료원의 변화
items.excerpt: 영월의료원은 환자 상태 악화·패혈증·심정지 위험 예측, 영상 판독 보조, 안과 질환 선별 등 4종의 의료 AI를 진료 현장에 쓰고 있다. 입원환자 생체징후와 검사 결과로 72시간 내 악화를 예측한다.

items.title: AI-derived inflammation score improves cardiovascular risk prediction beyond CAC
items.excerpt: An AI-derived measure of inflammation from noncontrast CT improves cardiovascular risk prediction beyond traditional coronary artery calcium scoring.

items.title: GC녹십자, 약물감시 지원 AI S/W 'PVLitrieve' 개발
items.excerpt: GC녹십자가 국내 제약사 최초로 생성형 AI 기반 약물감시(PV) 문헌 모니터링 소프트웨어 'PVLitrieve'를 개발했다.

items.title: 분당차병원, AI·데이터 기반 환자 중심 스마트 병원 구축
items.excerpt: 분당차병원이 AI·데이터 기반 환자 중심 스마트 병원 구축에 본격 착수했다.
